resources.string: Connect your Android phone directly to Android TV over local ADB. Control the TV, manage apps and files, and inspect commands and diagnostics.

Use the same reachable LAN. Enable TV ADB debugging and its TCP port (usually 5555), then approve authorization on the TV. Android 11+ wireless debugging needs pairing first; pairing and connection ports differ.

Some actions cannot be undone through this tool. Back up important data, understand the consequences, and follow the operation prompts. A timeout does not establish that an action failed to execute. ADB authorization may allow reading device information, transferring files, and executing management commands. Use trusted networks, grant persistent debugging access cautiously, and protect pairing information and connection credentials. Revoke debugging authorization on the device when no longer needed. This operation downloads the latest stable Aerial APK from its official GitHub repository, installs or upgrades it on the target TV, grants the permissions listed below, and launches Aerial. Confirm that you are authorized to manage this TV. Installation or device failures may affect use; back up important data before upgrading.
This operation uses ADB to grant the permissions listed below to Aerial already installed on the target TV, then launches it. Confirm that you are authorized to manage this TV.

Aerial will be granted or allowed to request access to location, secure and system settings, overlays, installation of other apps, app usage, notifications, and automatic or associated startup. The operation also attempts to allow restricted settings where supported. These permissions are granted to Aerial on the TV and may persist after this operation. Uninstall Aerial or follow its official instructions to revoke the relevant permissions when no longer needed.

Aerial Lite will be granted permission to write secure settings, allowing it to change system configuration on the TV. This permission may persist after the operation. Uninstall Aerial Lite or follow its official instructions to revoke this permission when no longer needed.
Permission support depends on the TV firmware. The authorization and launch results are shown after execution. Continue only if you understand and accept these changes.
